description: Manual curated items merged with RSS by scripts/merge_items.py

items.title: Germany — track adopted RES support, grid/UoS charges, and retail-bill levies for developer exposure
items.summary: Use BNetzA / BMWK primary texts to separate proposal vs adopted measures affecting RES auctions, EEG-related charges, TSO/DSO use-of-system evolution, and components of end-user electricity bills.
items.opportunity_note: Bill-component and UoS changes shift the boundary between merchant and regulated cash flows; confirm in adopted determinations rather than headlines.

items.title: United Kingdom — log BESS / flexibility consultations separately from adopted licences and grid connection rules
items.summary: Tag DESNZ/Ofgem consultations on storage and operability as proposal until published as statutory instruments or licence modifications; pair with NESO/NGESO technical notices when relevant.
items.opportunity_note: Consultation language on participation products may change before adoption—check final determinations and licence conditions.

items.title: Italy — monitor bollette and gas-linked bill measures; verify exact legal titles (TOPE and other labels)
items.summary: Italian policy debate sometimes refers to storage or tariff measures under shorthand labels (e.g. references to **TOPE**) and **bollette** components. **Do not** rely on nickname alone—open the **adopted** decree/law or ARERA resolution and copy the precise instrument title from primary texts (e.g. *Gazzetta Ufficiale*, MASE decrees, ARERA deliberations).
items.opportunity_note: Separating proposal vs adopted Italian measures is essential for RES/BESS bankability; treat media nicknames as pointers only.
